files.text:
SysBASIC 0.3.0
Classic docked workbench, BASIC subset and project save/load.
Build selects a standalone executable or an installer package. Installer wizard registers the application in the software library.
F11 opens the installed IDE.
Unsupported language/control features are documented in source/docs/ide.md.
